author: Bobby Grayson
message:
quant: port the IQ codebook family (IQ2_XXS/XS/S, IQ3_XXS/S, IQ4_NL/XS)

Encoders and decoders ported from ggml-quants.c at commit 48d22e295 (the
exact source of the installed llama.cpp), dropping the bpw floor from
4.5 to ~2.06. Lattice/codebook tables are script-extracted; kmap and
neighbour lists are rebuilt at first use with ggml's 3-pass algorithm.
Preserves ggml's fudge constants, sign-parity flips, and the
encoder-lattice vs tuned-decode-grid asymmetry. token_embd and output
are floored at IQ4_XS like llama.cpp's own IQ2 presets.

Differential validation on Qwen3-0.6B, same imatrix and held-out text:
shoehorn's solved 2.84bpw mix reaches PPL 212.7 at 207MB vs PPL 446.8
at 219MB for llama-quantize's IQ2_XXS preset.

author: Bobby Grayson
message:
shoehorn: exact-VRAM-fit imatrix quantizer for GGUF models

Own Rust implementations of ggml block formats (Q4_0/1, Q5_0/1, Q8_0,
Q4_K/Q5_K/Q6_K) with imatrix-weighted scale search; Lagrangian knapsack
solver picks a per-tensor mix landing within ~100KB of the Metal
working-set budget; llama.cpp runs the result.

Validated on Qwen3-0.6B: 99.98% budget utilization, +0.6% held-out PPL
at 46% of BF16 size, 210 tok/s on M4 Pro.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
